wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Five Form A rows sum 500.00+100.00+100.00+100.00+500.00 = 1300.00, equal to cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST is written 'N/A' on all four lines, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide). Cover line 2 carries a separate 60.37 <=$50 aggregate which is NEVER itemized - it is deliberately EXCLUDED from the basis; scoring the rows against line1+line2 (1360.37) would manufacture a false 60.37 mismatch, which is exactly the sub-$50 trap the brief warns about.

expenditures.detail: Eight Form B rows sum 40.00+16.83+83.11+228.50+495.00+24.09+20.00+43.09 = 950.62, exactly cover line 3 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. THE ARITHMETIC SETTLED ONE GLYPH, per the Rhodes rule: row 3's superscript cents group is drawn as a single joined double-stroke that reads equally well as a cursive '11', a 'u', or '44' even at 1200 dpi. Resolution did not decide it - the schedule sum did: the other seven rows total 867.51, and 950.62 - 867.51 = 83.11, so the cents are 11. No glyph re-read was allowed to override that.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr form prints no schedule total or page subtotal. Cover lines are the only PRINTED anchors and both gate exactly: p2 rows 1300.00 = cover line 1; p3 rows 950.62 = cover line 3. The filer also wrote '950,62' in pen BELOW the p3 footer, outside the grid entirely - his own total, not a field of the form, NOT transcribed as a row, and it corroborates 950.62.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2: geometry ok, 39 bands, pitch consistent; ink on bands 1-5 consecutively, nothing below = 5 rows emitted. rowbands.py p3: geometry ok, 39 bands; ink on bands 1-8 consecutively, nothing below = 8 rows emitted. Neither count needed interpolation.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: a 1200 dpi crop spanning bands 1-5 of the amount column renders '500 00', '100 00', '100 00', '100 00', '500 00' in that order - first and last row both present and in position; the control crop one pitch below band 5 renders EMPTY. p3: a 1200 dpi crop spanning bands 1-8 renders '40 00', '16 83', '83 11', '228 50', '495 00', '24 09', '20 00', '43 09' in order; the control crop one pitch below band 8 renders empty.
gates.balance_chain: 1300.00 + 60.37 - 950.62 = 409.75, and cover line 4 prints 409.75 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. CLOSES EXACTLY, and it is one of only two filings in this chunk whose full four-line cover identity (over-$50 + <=$50 - expenses = balance) reconciles with no filer error at all. The LAST REPORT column is 'N/A' on every line, so no cross-filing chain check applies.

escalation_note: 1200 dpi amount-cell crops on p2 (bands 1-5, control) and p3 (bands 1-8, control, plus band 3 alone for the disputed cents group); 1000-1200 dpi crops of the p2 name column and address column and of individual name cells on rows 1, 2 and 5; 800 dpi crops of the p3 date/vendor/purpose columns; 600 dpi crop of the cover anchor block.
notes: index.csv calls the candidate David Bigelow / office County Council; the cover reads 'DAVID K. BIGELOW', 'Name of Office: COUNTY COUNCIL', 'Office District: COUNTY COUNCIL SOUTH', party DEMOCRATIC - agrees, in scope. The 'TO ____ County Clerk' line reads 'CACHE'. Cover street address, PO box, ZIP, home phone and business phone all discarded at read time. Form A addresses are written in the clear (street + city + ZIP); only the city was kept from each and no state was written on any row, so donor_state is honestly blank throughout. Two donors (rows 1 and 5) share the same street address - transcribed independently, no relationship inferred. This filer writes in all-caps and several surnames are genuinely bistable at 1200 dpi; those rows carry low confidence and needs_review rather than a normalised guess.

contributions.note: date written '4-1-08' (two-digit year, parses to 2008). Surname escalated to 1200 dpi and still bistable: the glyphs are P-A-L-L-E-E with a trailing flourish, and could equally be PALLEW, PAULEE or PAULEY. The legible-glyph string is recorded at low confidence; no real surname was substituted. Street address and ZIP discarded at read time; no state was written.

date written '7-15-08'. Surname glyphs read K-R-A-N-I-C-H at 1200 dpi but the middle letters are cramped and could be KRAUICH or KRANICK; recorded as the legible-glyph string at low confidence. Street address and ZIP discarded; no state written.
date written '8-15-08'. Name is legible without escalation. Street address and ZIP discarded; no state written.
date written '9-16-08'. Street address and ZIP discarded; no state written.

date written '10-10-08'. GIVEN NAME UNRESOLVED: the third glyph is a bare open curve, bistable between C, E and L - this hand writes L with a closed loop elsewhere (PALLEE, SULLIVAN), which argues against L, but no reading is safe, so the literal glyph string 'DEC' is recorded at low confidence with needs_review rather than the plausible real name 'DEL'. Same street address as row 1; street and ZIP discarded, no state written.

expenditures.note: date written '3-17-08'. Amount carries a superscript '00' cents group -> 40.00.
date written '4-26-08'. Amount carries a superscript '83' cents group -> 16.83.

date written '7-3-08'. THE CENTS ARE AN ARITHMETIC RESOLUTION, not a glyph read: the superscript is one joined double-stroke that reads as '11', 'u' or '44' even in a 1200 dpi cell crop. The other seven rows total 867.51 and the printed cover total is 950.62, so the cents must be 11. Flagged needs_review and low amount-confidence so a human can confirm the value the arithmetic forced.
date written '7-16-08'. Amount reads 228 at 1200 dpi (the second digit is a 2, not a 0 - at 90 dpi it looked like 208); superscript '50' cents -> 228.50.

date written '7-28-08'. The leading C of CAPITOL is drawn as an angular open form (the same hand draws CANDY the same way on row 8), so it is a C, not an A. Amount carries a superscript '00' cents group -> 495.00.

date written '8-29-08'. Amount carries a superscript '00' cents group -> 20.00.
